name: suite-is-product-source
body: `opencode-suite/**` is product source: the tools and the shared lib are embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` in `rust.apg.install` (`src/install.rs`, whose `SUITE_TOOLS` table carries the `apg_plan_phases.ts` entry) and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/`. The repo's own `.opencode/**` are consumer artifacts regenerated out-of-band from the installed release and are never edited here. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
